lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in approximately six vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Each column contains 3 to 4 distinct spots, forming a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal carinae, creating anchor nodes where the primary high-intensity spots are located.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges (carinae) run horizontally across the visible flank. Each ridge is defined by a sharp vertical gradient, with high-reflectance pixels on the upper edge and lower-intensity shadow pixels on the lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several fine, white linear abrasions are visible on the anterior-dorsal surface. A dark, vertically-oriented crease or marking is present immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a gradient of spot density, with a high concentration of small, high-luminance spots along the leading edge transitioning to larger, more sparse spots towards the center of the fin surface.
